Name: (SVE) Stardew Valley Expanded Companions - NPC Adventures-unofficial-mardrest
Author: mardrest
TagLine:
Adds SVE NPC's to NPC Adventures, making them recruitable companions.
It has the English, Spanish and Portuguese translation.
Description:
This adds [Stardew Valley Expanded](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753) NPC's (created by [FlashShifter](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252) ) to the [It's Time to Adventure (NPC Adventures)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582?tab=description)  mod (created by [PurrplingCat](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68185132) ).

Each NPC was given unique companion dialogue and combat phrases, although
the dialogue is very much a WIP and will be expanded upon. I tried to
stick to each of their characters and archetypes, but this dialogue was
not created by FlashShifter and may not be considered cannon. I also
created some new sprites for Andy, Marlon, Olivia, and Susan so that
each character would have more than 1 idle animation.

This mod is meant to be played with the version 1.0.2 of the NPC Adventures mod.
***This uses the sprites from my [Slightly Cuter Sprites for Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4648)  mod.**
